label.fr: Page de présentation d'une application mobile
label.en: Marketing page of a mobile app

expects.rule: The first screen says what the app does in one headline and shows the official App Store and Google Play badges (or a QR code on desktop) without scrolling.
Show real screens of the app, not abstract illustrations, with a caption saying what each screen does.
If the app is not released, say so plainly (Coming soon, Launching autumn 2026) and offer a waitlist or early-access link instead of dead store badges.
Price, free tier or free credits, and the platforms supported are stated on the page.
Privacy and data handling are summarised and linked, above all for finance, health and messaging apps.

The page works on a phone first: pointer targets of at least 24 by 24 CSS px (WCAG 2.2 minimum), 44 by 44 px for the main download button as a house target, no horizontal scroll, no desktop-only hover.
Motion and loaders must not block the first screen; offer a way to skip an intro.

traits: 7 of 7 pair two named typefaces; 4 of 7 (GoShuin, Wispr Flow, ACTL, Serus) set the headline in a serif or a display serif and the rest in a sans-serif.
The headline is large: 96 to 122 px on 5 of 7 (GoShuin, Fighter Ready, Wispr Flow, VOID, ACTL); Grassfeld uses 58 px and Serus 40 px.
The first screen holds fewer than 45 words on 6 of 7; Fighter Ready carries more because of its section nav and intro paragraph.
One filled or outlined button is the main action on 6 of 7; only 1 of 7 (GoShuin) shows an App Store link on the first screen, so most pages ask for sign-up, a waitlist or a download by platform.
A phone mockup appears on the first screen of 2 of 7 (Grassfeld, VOID); the rest use a type-led layout, a 3D scene, a book cover or a live input box.
3 of 7 use a dark background (Fighter Ready, VOID, ACTL) and 4 of 7 a light or warm one; each has one accent: orange, lime, lime, lilac or blue.
Navigation has three to five links on 5 of 7; 3 of 7 add a skip control, intro loader or cover to open before the content.
2 of 7 show a cookie banner over the first screen.

sites.name: GoShuin
sites.why: Split first screen on a warm off-white (#e7e5df): a 114 px serif GoShuin title, tagline and two underlined text links (App Store, Explore the app) on the left, a closed journal cover on the right. Headings set in Georgia, UI in a system sans-serif; a page counter at the bottom.

sites.name: Fighter Ready
sites.why: Starts with a black (#080808) loader with logo and a 'Lacing up' percentage, then a 122 px two-line headline in Barlow Condensed with Inter body, orange (#ff6a00) button, section nav, early-access link and a launch-date line. The page runs about 14 screens.

sites.name: Grassfeld
sites.why: White-to-light-blue panel: a 58 px heavy headline set in Right Grotesk at left with one dark Get Started button, a phone showing the budget screen with floating cards at right. Header has five links and a flag toggle; a cookie banner covers the lower third. Manrope for body.

sites.name: Wispr Flow
sites.why: Centred 96 px headline in EB Garamond with an italic second line on pale yellow (#ffffeb), a lilac (#f0d7ff) button with dark outline, a platforms line, and looping text ribbons around a waveform pill. No image; Figtree for the interface. Green announcement bar above the header.

sites.name: VOID Messenger
sites.why: Black screen with a huge all-caps lime (#e7ff56) headline in QB One with two padlock icons, a phone lock-screen mockup under it, a floating pill nav of four links plus a lime Subscribe button, and a feature tab strip with a Skip the intro button. Gilroy for text.

sites.name: ACTL
sites.why: Navy (#0a2952) screen: a 105 px bold serif headline in cream, one short paragraph and a lime (#aaf136) Join via WhatsApp button at left, a 3D tennis court taking the right half, a 01/03 slide counter. Header has four links and an outlined button. Body in Montreal.

sites.name: Serus
sites.why: Near-white (#fafafa) first screen with a 40 px serif greeting in Reckless above a single rounded search box (attach, Search tips, model selector), a privacy line under it, Log in, a black waitlist button and a lilac sign-up button in the header. A cookie card sits bottom left.

avoid: A grid of identical feature cards with an icon, a three-word title and one sentence.
Phone mockups showing blurred or invented screens instead of the real interface.
Store badges that link to a page that does not exist yet.
Purple-to-blue gradient hero with floating glass cards and no product screen.
Fake review counts, invented download numbers or unnamed 'trusted by' logos.
Unskippable full-screen intro or loader before the headline.

sources.name: Awwwards, per-site pages (GoShuin, Fighter Ready, Grassfeld, Wispr Flow, VOID, ACTL, Serus)
